formal_acts.name: Formal acts and law
formal_acts.description: Laws, bills, votes, decrees, regulations, treaties, directives, strategies and formal commitments.

resources.name: Resources
resources.description: Authorized and actual spending, staffing, procurement, contracts, equipment and infrastructure.

personnel.name: Personnel
personnel.description: Appointments, removals, qualifications, conflicts, tenure and practical autonomy.

implementation.name: Implementation and operational conduct
implementation.description: Delivery, enforcement, administration, inspection, compliance, correction and remedy.

communications.name: Rhetoric and representations
communications.description: Speeches, testimony, interviews, promises, explanations, threats, denials, propaganda and corrections.

outcomes.name: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Observed changes in conduct, institutions, rights, security, welfare, delivery and compliance.

lenses.title: Reducing existential risk
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler try to make catastrophic conflict less likely?

lenses.title: Responsible nuclear rhetoric
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler speak about nuclear weapons responsibly?

lenses.title: Safe nuclear control
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler keep nuclear weapons and decisions safe and controlled?

lenses.title: Arms control and inspections
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler support and follow agreements that reduce nuclear danger?

lenses.title: Nuclear cover for aggression
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler avoid using nuclear power to protect aggression or repression?

lenses.title: Preventing proliferation
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler stop allies, clients, and domestic actors from spreading nuclear weapons?

lenses.title: Independent risk expertise
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler empower qualified experts who could warn about catastrophic risks?

lenses.title: Crisis de-escalation
lenses.simple_question: During crises, did the ruler act to prevent catastrophic escalation?

lenses.title: Other catastrophic risks
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler manage AI, cyber, biological, and similar catastrophic risks carefully?

lenses.title: Lasting risk posture
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler leave the country’s catastrophic-risk posture safer than before?

lenses.title: Peaceful alternatives
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler seriously try peaceful options before using force?

lenses.title: Starting or prolonging war
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler start or unnecessarily prolong aggression or war?

lenses.title: Honest justification for force
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler explain honestly why force was needed?

lenses.title: Civilian and prisoner protection
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler protect civilians and prisoners during conflict?

lenses.title: Control of proxies and arms
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler prevent supported forces and arms recipients from causing abuse?

lenses.title: Scrutiny of war claims
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler allow independent checks of claims made about conflict?

lenses.title: Ceasefires and settlements
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler seriously pursue and uphold peace agreements?

lenses.title: Responsible military resources
lenses.simple_question: Were military resources used for real security rather than power, profit, or intimidation?

lenses.title: Accountability and remedy
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler accept responsibility and remedy unlawful harm from conflict?

lenses.title: Lasting international peace
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler leave international relations more peaceful and lawful?

lenses.title: Protection from state abuse
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler protect people from torture, disappearance, political imprisonment, and unlawful killing?

lenses.title: Control of coercive forces
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler prevent and punish abuse by security forces and aligned groups?

lenses.title: Incitement and targeted hatred
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler avoid encouraging hatred or violence against people or groups?

lenses.title: Complaints and independent oversight
lenses.simple_question: Could abuse be reported, investigated, corrected, and remedied independently?

lenses.title: Emergency and surveillance powers
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler use exceptional security powers narrowly and lawfully?

lenses.title: Safety without state terror
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler reduce violence without creating a broader climate of fear?

lenses.title: Protection of vulnerable groups
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler protect vulnerable groups from violence, displacement, and neglect?

lenses.title: Safe protest and dissent
lenses.simple_question: Could people protest, dissent, and organize without unlawful retaliation?

lenses.title: Restrained crisis response
lenses.simple_question: During domestic crises, did the ruler protect people without collective punishment or spectacle?

lenses.title: Lasting domestic safety
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler leave people safer from state and non-state violence?

lenses.title: Genuine electoral choice
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler support elections in which they could truly lose?

lenses.title: No entrenchment of power
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler avoid changing or abusing institutions to stay in power?

lenses.title: Opposition and civic freedom
lenses.simple_question: Could opponents, journalists, protesters, and civic groups criticize the ruler safely?

lenses.title: Independent checks on power
lenses.simple_question: Did courts, legislatures, auditors, and other institutions remain able to constrain the ruler?

lenses.title: Politically neutral institutions
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler avoid filling neutral institutions with loyalists and political pressure?

lenses.title: Independent information and media
lenses.simple_question: Could people receive independent information rather than censorship and propaganda?

lenses.title: Equal political rights
lenses.simple_question: Did all groups have equal political rights and access?

lenses.title: Term limits and transfer
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler respect succession rules and peaceful transfer of power?

lenses.title: Digital freedom and surveillance
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler avoid using surveillance and digital controls to suppress politics?

lenses.title: Lasting democratic resilience
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler leave political freedom and democracy stronger?

lenses.title: Broad and sustainable prosperity
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler pursue lasting prosperity for the public rather than private gain and political loyalty?

lenses.title: Qualified economic leadership
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler empower capable economic professionals rather than loyalists?

lenses.title: Macroeconomic stability
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler protect stable public finances, money, debt, and investment conditions?

lenses.title: Fair economic rules
lenses.simple_question: Did businesses and workers operate under fair and predictable economic rules?

lenses.title: Resistance to economic capture
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler resist favoritism, monopoly power, and politically connected privilege?

lenses.title: Productive public investment
lenses.simple_question: Did public resources produce useful foundations for long-term prosperity?

lenses.title: Evidence and correction
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler use honest evidence and correct economic policies that failed?

lenses.title: Fair distribution
lenses.simple_question: Were economic gains and burdens shared fairly across people and regions?

lenses.title: Managing economic shocks
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler respond competently and fairly to major economic shocks?

lenses.title: Lasting economic trajectory
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler leave the economy on a stronger and fairer path?

lenses.title: Welfare as a governing purpose
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler make people's wellbeing a real priority?

lenses.title: Access to essential services
lenses.simple_question: Did people gain effective access to essential services and social protection?

lenses.title: Priority for vulnerable groups
lenses.simple_question: Did vulnerable people and poor regions receive real protection and support?

lenses.title: Professional service delivery
lenses.simple_question: Were social services run by capable people with adequate resources?

lenses.title: Measurement and correction
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler measure social programs honestly and fix what did not work?

lenses.title: Protection during crises
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler reduce avoidable suffering during major crises?

lenses.title: No political allocation of welfare
lenses.simple_question: Were benefits and basic needs protected from political favoritism and punishment?

lenses.title: Dignity and equal opportunity
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler protect equal dignity and opportunity in everyday life?

lenses.title: Durable social institutions
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler build social institutions that could last beyond personal rule?

lenses.title: Lasting life chances
lenses.simple_question: Did ordinary people finish the period with better life chances?

lenses.title: Truthfulness
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler tell the truth when lying could protect their power or reputation?

lenses.title: Correcting falsehoods and errors
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler admit and correct false claims and mistakes?

lenses.title: Conflicts of interest
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler keep personal and family interests separate from public decisions?

lenses.title: Personal profit from office
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler or close family improperly profit from public office?

lenses.title: Nepotism and loyalist appointments
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler choose officials for competence rather than personal loyalty or connections?

lenses.title: Independent investigation
lenses.simple_question: Could independent institutions investigate the ruler and close associates?

lenses.title: Obstruction and concealment
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler obey accountability processes rather than obstruct or conceal wrongdoing?

lenses.title: Promises and good faith
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler keep commitments and explain changes honestly?

lenses.title: Favoritism and clientelism
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler avoid using public power to reward favored people and networks?

lenses.title: Ethical example and public trust
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler's conduct strengthen ethical standards and public trust?

lenses.title: Clear governing program
lenses.simple_question: Were the ruler's real goals clear enough to evaluate?

lenses.title: Turning goals into machinery
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler turn goals into concrete plans, rules, resources, people, and institutions?

lenses.title: Mobilizing the ruling system
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler effectively mobilize the state and ruling network toward those goals?

lenses.title: Capable implementers
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler choose and manage people capable of carrying out the program?

lenses.title: Coordination and control
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler maintain coordination and follow-through across the system?

lenses.title: From plans to practice
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler turn plans and announcements into real government action?

lenses.title: Progress toward chosen goals
lenses.simple_question: Did results move toward the ruler's own goals?

lenses.title: Learning and correction
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler adapt and correct course when methods failed?

lenses.title: Managing crises and resistance
lenses.simple_question: Did the ruler handle crises and resistance without losing the chosen program?

lenses.title: Durable goal achievement
lenses.simple_question: By the end, had the ruler achieved more of the program in a lasting way?
